title: LightPC documentation meta
description: Describes the meta.json every docs directory carries. The reader uses it to list versions and to build the document tree.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema, resolved against the meta.json location.

version.description: Version shown in the documentation picker.

index.description: Markdown rendered before a document is chosen, relative to the meta.json directory.

deprecated.description: Marks a set that is kept for reference only.

tags.description: Free form labels used for filtering.

local.description: True when the documents ship with the application instead of being fetched.

toc.description: Two level table of contents: a group name maps to the documents it holds.

additionalProperties.description: Documents of one group, keyed by the title shown in the tree.
Markdown path relative to the meta.json directory.

remote.description: Reserved for sets that are fetched instead of shipped.
